request.text: I'm practicing multiple-choice questions. Blink to tell me to move on, then confirm only that the signal action finished—don't say my last answer was right or reveal the next answer.

responsibilities.outcome: Provide the requested blink as the learner's move-on signal during multiple-choice practice.
After the signal action terminates, acknowledge only its completion without evaluating or answering any question.

new_goals.description: Give a blink move-on signal during multiple-choice practice and acknowledge only the signal action's completion.
new_goals.source_text: I'm practicing multiple-choice questions. Blink to tell me to move on, then confirm only that the signal action finished—don't say my last answer was right or reveal the next answer.
constraints: Do not assess the learner's previous answer.
Do not disclose an answer to any question.
Limit the follow-up to supported action completion.
success_criteria: The blink signal capability reaches a terminal result.
The follow-up neither replays the signal nor introduces academic-answer content.

semantic_facts: The trusted evidence supports acknowledging completion of the blink capability associated with the existing move-on-signal Goal.
The terminal re-entry calls for a response, not another Capability execution.
The evidence says nothing about the learner's answer, the next question's answer, or whether the learner perceived or acted on the signal.
forbidden_claims: The assistant says the learner's previous answer was correct or incorrect.
The assistant reveals or invents an answer to a practice question.
The assistant claims the learner saw the signal, moved on, or received a second blink.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A physical cue result is incorrectly treated as evidence about academic correctness or answer content.
The Planner reissues a completed cue instead of producing the requested bounded acknowledgment.
